balls.text: Straightish mid-on does not matter because Dube has absolutely powered it straight as an arrow. In the slot outside off, he beats long-off to his left and CSK finish on 103 for 9
Very full outside off, jams his bat down to direct it through point. Shouts "do aa" and hares back for two. CSK move to 99!
Full and outside off, he thumps it to long-on, they don't take the run
Short ball outside off, Dube swings hard and gets a top edge. Flies over the wicketkeeper and he gets four
A misfield from Narine draws cheers from the Chepauk! Full toss in line of the stumps, he swings hard and gets a thick inside edge. Narine at square leg misses it completely
Yorker just outside off, he fails to dig it out
Short and well wide outside off, easy leave
Very full just outside off, dug out through mid-on to retain strike
Gets a thick inside edge as Dube looks to pull a length ball across the line. Goes off his pads and rolls to the off side
Full and wide outside off, called wide for the line. Passed just outside the tramline
Very full outside off again, squeezed to backward point
Bludgeoned down the ground! Rana goes full again, outside off, Dube manages to connect this time and thumps it back over the non-striker. A boundary after 63 balls for CSK
Very full and outside off, Dube fails to reach it. Another dot at the death
Full and wide outside off, he goes hard at it and is beaten
Short and wide outside off, he goes for the upper cut but misses
Full and outside off, it is the slower one, Kamboj flicks the clip in the air towards deep midwicket and takes two
Bouncer angling down leg, he goes for the pull but misses. Wide called but KKR review> The TV umpire checks the Ultra-Edge, which rules out the edge. The on-field call stays
Short from around the wicket, he pulls it wide of Russell at long-on but gets just one
Goes for the yorker on leg, Kamboj gets enough bat to flick it to fine leg. CSK escape from equalling their lowest IPL total

A diving catch from Varun! He covers good ground to his left from short fine leg and dives to hang on to that. KKR's night getting better and better. This is dug in short from Arora, Noor goes for the tail-ender's across-the-line swipe and top edges it
Full outside off, he squeezes it through cover
Fuller around off, pushed defensively to cover
Fuller on off, driven back to the bowler
This one spins in from a length, he fails to nudge it away
Spins away this time after landing on a length. Noor has no clue of that and plays for the inspinning ball but is well away from the outside edge
Quicker one angled it in on middle and leg, he defended it off the inner edge
Quicker on leg, clipped through midwicket. He does take the single. It was bowled at 111kph
Goes back and hurriedly gets his bat down to punch it towards the bowler. Narine with a three-for
Spins away from a length, Dube stays still and clips it to long-on
Fuller on off, he gets a thick outside edge well away from slip

Huge appeal, given out lbw! Dhoni shows the bat to the umpire, and then takes the review. Tossed up on a length on off, not sure if he read it. He comes forward and right across the line and looks to turn it across. Misses it on the inner half. Is there an inside edge like Dhoni felt rightaway? Yes there is! Or not! The TV umpire sees the murmur but rules out the presence of the inside edge. Three reds on the ball-tracker and Dhoni is also out of here. Massive this! There was a tiny spike. And Dhoni walks out without any further word with the on-field umpires, something we routinely see with batters not happy with such calls. It is what it is and CSK in danger of their lowest IPL total
Length ball on middle, whipped through backward square leg off the inner half
Spins away from a length outside off, he goes back to cut but misses
Fuller outside off, comes forward and drives it off the outer half to backward point
Fuller outside off, slapped through cover
Bat-pad over short leg! He pushes forward at that with hard hands, gets a thick inside edge. Flies behind square on the leg side and Dhoni is underway
Full outside off, he comes forward to drive it to cover

Chipped to short midwicket. This is all easy for KKR. Wheels are coming off for CSK at home. Varun slips this in on a length, it skids on a touch. Hooda goes back to whip it across but spoons it towards short midwicket, where Arora dives forward and takes it. Varun did not even bother celebrating
Length ball on leg, clipped through forward square ;eg
Tossed up outside off, he goes for the drive and is beaten on the inside. Was not too far from off, the bounce saves Hooda there
Spins in from a length, he goes back to whip it away but misses
Fuller outside off, pushed to cover

Nicked behind? Yes says the umpire and Jadeja is out of here Narine lands it on a length outside off, it spins away. Jadeja goes poking at it and feathers it behind. Whistles ring out at the Chepauk...
Flatter on a length outside off, punched through cover
Fuller on middle, turns it away, defended from the crease
Length ball on off, defended towards point

Catching practice for long-on! Thought Ashwin hit that well but he did it too well for KKR's liking. Back of a length aimed in line of the stumps, he goes back to pull it over the on side. Ended up flat-batting it straight to Arora, who did not have to move an inch
Back of a length outside off, 138kph, he looks to ramp but is beaten
Length ball on off, he stands back and mistimes it to cover
Length ball just outside off, it is the offcutter, 114.2kph, he looks to tap and run but it goes towards the bowler
Back of a length slanting away, he arches back, makes room and steers it to deep third
Length ball now, around off, spinning in a touch, keeps it out to short midwicket off the back foot. A superb spell from Mo ends
Nicely lobbed up, full just outside off, he flicks it to short midwicket
Over the wicket now, spins it away from Dube outside off, slapped to deep cover
Spins in from a length on off, he taps it to the on side and sprints to the other end
A tad full on off, he goes back and punches it through to long-off
Slides it down leg, 96kph, he plays inside the line of that
Tossed up full on off, from around the stumps, he pushes it to the off side

Beauty! A perplexed Tripathi has to walk back. Not that he looked the part all night. Tossed up on a length outside off, it rips in after landing. Not sure Tripathi picked that as he looks to make room and slap it through the off side. He is beaten on the inside and sees his off stump pegged back. Massive trouble for CSK now
Spinning away from a length, punched through point. Singles won't hurt KKR
Shortish on off, chops the pull to deep midwicket
On middle and leg, he goes back and punches it to long-on
Charges down to the length ball that spins in, he misses his whip and it goes off his pad to short third
Quicker one just outside off, steered to backward point
Flatter length ball on middle and leg, he works this to long-on for a run
Flatter on off, he eases this down to long-off for a run

Straight down the throat of deep backward square leg. And Vijay Shankar's luck finally runs out. Was the quicker legbreak from Varun on middle and leg. He gets across his stumps and looks to go much finer. But, can only hit this as far as Moeen, who takes a comfortable catch
Pushed quicker on a length on off, he pushes to point with a slight open face of the bat
Stifle short on the stumps, he pulls to the right of Rinku at long-on. Some excellent running from Tripathi gets them two
Darts the good length ball on leg stump, Tripathi rocks back and flat bats this to long-on
Quicker length ball outside off, he punches this straight to extra cover
Tad short outside off, he slams the pull to the left of deep midwicket where Ramandeep is quick on the ball and prevents the second run
Fired in at 94kph on off, he pushes towards covers and sets off
Flatter length ball on off. The ball sticks on the surface and gets big on the batter who adjusts and works this to deep midwicket
Dragged down on off, he goes back and pulls to deep midwicket
Flatter length ball on middle and leg, he works this behind square
Slower back of a length ball outside off, Tripathi misses the cut as de Kock collects this on the bounce
Sharp back of a length ball outside off, but there's too much width for Tripathi who runs this off the middle of the bat to the deep third fence
Another slower offcutter on middle and leg, Tripathi works this to midwicket
On pace length ball on middle and leg, he works this to Iyer misfields again and concedes a run

Oh, my word, Venkatesh Iyer has completely lost that in the lights. And Vijay has another life. Excellent slower ball does Vijay all ends up. Was the offcutter on middle and leg. Vijay is too early into his flick and chips the simplest of chances to Iyer at midwicket. He sprints forward and then completely loses it
Banged in short outside off and Vijay sways outside the line.
Shimmies down the track to the 81.5kph length ball and works this to the right of deep midwicket. Some excellent running gets them two
Too short but gets away with it. Was darted in at 101kph on middle and leg, he pulls to deep backward square leg
Tosses the length ball on middle, Tripahthi sweeps but only as far as short fine leg
Slower length ball outside off, he cuts this to deep point
Goes high, and goes long... just enough. Floated just around off stump. He bends down on one knee and slogs this. Wasn't off the middle of the bat but  had enough power to clear deep midwicket
Tossed up on off, he eases this to long-on
Too full on middle and leg, he flicks this neatly in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket for a couple of runs

Chips it and gets four more. Flatter length ball right in Vijay's slot outside off. He presents the full face of the bat and goes straight. Long-on is fairly wide and that gets Vijay a second straight four
Finds the gap and there is a first boundary after 17 deliveries. Flatter good length ball on middle and leg, he stays back and pulls it away past short fine leg
Very flat at 92kph on off and middle, Tripathi stays back and bunts this to point for a run
Darts this in at 98kph on middle stump, he ticks this to short midwicket
Flatter on off stump, he drives to mid-off with some power and sets off. Russell misfields and they get two
And, again! Sharp back of a length ball outside off which keeps a tad low. Vijay shapes up for a cut but gets beaten again
Sharp back of a length ball at 138kph outside off. He eyes a pull and gets beaten one more time
On a length outside off, he drives to cover

Another leading edge... but Narine has dropped an absolute sitter at mid-off. Did Narine take that too easy? Was a length ball on off, Vijay was looking to work it to the on-side, but he closes the face of the bat too early. Gets a big fat leading edge that balloons straight to Narine, who shells it
Play and a miss first ball! Back of a length ball outside off at decent pace. Vijay looks to carve it away, but can't lay a bat on it

Leading edge and Rachin now departs. This has gone from bad to worse for CSK. Starts off with a length ball on leg stump. Rachin was looking to leg side, gets a big leading edge that goes straight up and Rahane at extra cover takes a simple catch
Fizzes this through on a length outside off. Tripathi gives himself room searching for  a cut and misses. That's a maiden wicket from Moeen.
Flatter length ball on off, Tripathi pushes this back towards the bowler
Stifle short on off, he pulls but straight to short midwicket
Tossed up on off, he stretches forward and defends back towards the bowler
Tossed on middle and leg, Tripathi works this to square leg and sets off only to be sent back by Rachin

Huge appeal for lbw as the umpire's finger is up. Goes a touch flatter on middle and leg. Conway goes reverse, misses and is struck in front. This looks real close on first viewing. There is no bat, on we go. Pitching in line, impact in line and the ball would have gone on to clip the outer half of the leg stump. But, because the on-field umpire had given this out, the decision stands and CSK are one down in the fourth over with not many on the board
Too full outside off, Ravindra gives himself room and ends up slicing this with an open face of the bat, but straight backward point
Quick run and they make it hope easy. Good length ball on off, he opens the face of the bat and guides to point. There is a direct hit but Rachin was in
BANG! On a length on off, he goes straight and in between mid-on and mid-off for an important four

Fuller on middle stump, Rachin backs away looking to pierce the gap in the off side. But he can only dig this to cover point. Moeen has a shy at the striker's end and Ravindra was a goner with a direct hit. He misses and they get an overthrow instead.
On a length on middle and leg, Ravindra, who is on the move, pushes this back to the bowler
Sharp good length ball on off and middle, Ravindra pushes at it with hard hands and gets a thick inside-edge onto pad
Sprays the fuller length ball down leg, Conway flicks this but can't beat short fine leg
Floated gently outside off, Ravindra bunts this towards cover and sets off
Tossed up on the stumps, Conway stays leg side of the ball and drives on the up to mid-off who it now back on the ropes
Top fielding from Rinku. Saves three runs, easily. Tossed  up outside off, he drives with some power to the right of Rinku at mid-off, who dives full-length
A bit of grip and turn for Moeen who tosses this up outside off. Ravindra pushes at it and gets a thick outside edge past slip
And he strikes almost right away. Tossed up on off, he pushes at it with hard hands and skews it off the inside half of the bat to the left of Moeen and just out of his reach
Good length ball outside off stump, Conway scythes it to deep point for a run
On a length just outside off with a hint of shape away and pushes towards cover
THUMPED! Width on offer outside off from Arora and Conway cashes in. Frees his arms and hammers the cover drive with some authority
Steps down the track to the length ball on middle, giving himself just a little bit of room but can only push it towards cover
Goes a touch fuller just around off stump, Conway jabs at it and gets a thick inside-edge onto pad.
On a length just around middle and leg stump as Ravindra pushes towards mid-off and sets off

Rinku finishes it off in style and quickly at that! Tossed up full on middle and leg, he gets under it and sends it high and long over deep backward square leg. KKR win big with eight wickets and 59 balls to spare
Starts with a length ball darted across him on off, he swings it across to deep midwicket. And Jadeja has overstepped
Fuller outside off, sliced to deep point
The wrong'un tossed up outside off, Rinku goes for the glory hit over the off side but is beaten on the inside
Finds the boundary!  Floated full outside off, he slogs it off the inner half over midwicket. The man in the deep was squarer
Nicely tossed up outside off, Rinku backs away to go big but only makes contact with thin air. Importantly, he wasn't out of the crease
Quicker one on a length on middle, Rinku goes back to nudge it back to the bowler
Almost hit back at Noor! He puts his hand up to catch it up it flies down to long-on. It was tossed up outside off, Rahane went for the slog
Full on off, Rahane knocks it down to long-on
Floated full on middle, eased down to long-off
Tossed up on a length on off, Rahane looks to whip it across but misses. He is hit on the flap of the front pad, only Ashwin appeals. And as the ball rolls towards short third, they scamper for one
Length bal outside off, punched back
Dropped? Did it carry? Yes it does. Shortish on the stumps, Rahane goes back and pulls it towards deep midwicket, where Vijay runs in and gets low but cannot hang on
Fuller outside off, pushed to cover
Darted in outside off, he runs this fine but can't beat point
Quicker length ball on off, he pushes to point and sets off
Fired in at 96kph on leg stump, he works this to short fine leg
Wrong'un outside off, he pushes back to the bowler
Darted i outside off, he cuts this to point
Cleans up Narine first ball. But what a stunning cameo this has been from the opener. Pushed quicker on off stump. Narine looks to mow this across the line, misses and sees his off stump flattened.
Tossed up just outside off, he defends to the offside
Stifle shorter and quicker on middle, he shapes up for the pull, gets a thick inside edge towards square leg
Too full outside off, Narine stays still and tonks him over long-off for six more.
No watching around this time. Offbreak just outside leg stump, he winds up and sends this soaring over deep backward square leg for a huge six
Pushed quicker outside off stump, Narine watches closely and shoulders arms
Stifle short on off, he pushes to long-on for a run
Beats the fielder. KKR doing it in a hurry. Slower back of a length ball on hi hips and Narine just helps this to the left of deep backward square leg for four more
Fuller but down leg, called a wide
Slower back of a length ball just outside leg stump. Narine gives himself room again and misses. Dhoni misfields as well but no harm done
Add six more to Narine's tally. On a length on leg stump, was a slower ball. Narine clears his front leg, and pumps this over wide long-on
Conway saves a certain boundary at point. Fuller outside off, he creams the square drive and Conway dives to his left to intercept and save three runs
Picked away with disdain! Length ball on Rahane's pads. He stays still and effortlessly helps this 69m over deep square leg for six more
On a length on the off stump, met by a full face of the bat from Rahane
Good length ball shaping back into Rahane on off. He opens the face of the bat and guides to deep third
Pushed fuller again outside off, he drives in the gap through covers for a couple of runs
On a length on the stumps, Rahane gets it off the inside half of the bat to the on-side
Shot of the match? Kamboj gets greedy and goes too full. Ends up bowling this right in Rahane's slot on off stump. He presents the full face of the bat and drives with elegance past the bowler
On a length on off, Rahane gets right behind it and defends

Cleans him and CSK have wicket No. 1! Good length ball on off stump, de Kock was looking to mow this over corner. Misses and sees his off pole pegged back. Kamboj celebrates. CSK need to strike some 6-7 times in the next few overs to make any match out of this.
Goes reverse now and misses again. Flatter outside off, Narine gets beaten
Backs away quite a bit but Ashwin follows him and darts this on his pads as Narine misses. The ball rolls to short fine leg
Carrom ball that is pumped for six more. Narine is on a roll. Dragged down on a touch on leg stump and Narine pulls this over deep square leg
On a length on his pads, he works this to the on-side
Flatter on leg stump, Narine miscues his slog to deep midwicket
Gives himself room outside leg stump but Ashwin follows him. Narine still manages to free his arms and slams him in between mid-off and extra cover

Top edge and that has travelled for a huge six! Banged in short aiming for de Kock's helmet. He goes for a pull which ends being a top edge but such is the force he generates the ball went to the second tier over deep fine leg
On a length outside off, he mistimes his punch towards cover
No stopping this one! Wayward length ball down leg. He stays still and picks this with glee over deep backward square leg for a 73m six.
Good length ball outside off, he punches to backward point
Fullish on a length on the stumps, he gives himself room and hacks this to the right of mid-on where Noor puts in a dive and saves a few runs
Banged in short aiming for Narine's body who has to move outside the line of that. Called a wide on height

Oh, what an effort from Kamboj. Had that stuck, surely it would have been the catch of the season. Length ball on the pads of de Kock who whips it with authority to the right of deep backward square leg. Kamboj sprints to his right, flings out his right hand in a hope that the ball would stick. But it hits him on the wrist.
On a length on the off stump as de Kock presents the full of his bat and drives neatly to the left of mid-off for a run
Keeps it on a length on the stumps as Narine gives himself room again and swats this to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, Narine takes his right leg out of the way and was looking to go straight down. Miscues to mid-on but Hooda over-runs the ball and concedes an extra run
Length ball on middle stump, Narime stays legside of the ball and miscues to mid-on
Can't quite cash in. On a length on the stumps, he looks to dump this over cow corner, can only manage a thick inside-edge on to pad as the ball lobs to the on-side
On a length shaping away from de Kock who shoulders arms. Oh, hang on, the buzzers are off in Chepauk which means that Kamboj has overstepped
BANG! Welcome to the bowling crease, says de Kock as he stays still and hammers the back of a length ball on off for a huge six over deep midwicket
Going, going and gone! He is not holding back. Back of a length ball coming back into Narine, who stands still and whacks a pull miles over deep midwicket.
On a length on de Kock's pads, who works this behind square to get off the mark
On a length on middle, and the ball straightens after pitching as de Kock pushes back towards the bowler.
Low full toss and he misses out. That swung in late meeting the batter shin-high on middle and leg. De Kock works this to short midwicket
Gets a good length ball to slant back into de Kock who pushes back to the bowler
Sharp good length ball to start off around off stump, de Kock defends towards point
